title: Python Run Stage Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Python for Robotics
description: Open the six stages a Python script passes through between pressing Enter and seeing output, then sort five real error messages onto the stage that produces each one. Used in Chapter 1.

educational.topic: The stages of running a Python script and the error each stage produces
learningObjectives: Classify each of five Python error messages by the stage of running a script that produces it, with at least 4 of 5 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Open every stage definition first, then sort real messages onto the visible sequence with one attempt each and immediate feedback
keyQuestions: Which messages come from the shell, and which come from Python?
Why does a SyntaxError appear before any print output?
Why does a missing module show up only when its import line runs?
commonMisconceptions: Python checks the whole program for every kind of error before running any line
command not found is a Python error
A ModuleNotFoundError means the module file is broken
assessmentOpportunities: Five committed stage choices, one attempt each; 4 of 5 for mastery

controls.label: Stage
values: 1 to 6, the six stages in order

controls.label: Start sorting / Check / Next message / See score / Try again
Click a stage row to open it or to choose it as the answer
